config.question: How does the incremental target-selection value of individual scores and cached interaction representations change with locally available experimental labels?
config.nearest_known_answer: Binding versus affinity outputs have different intended uses. Target-label priors, local affinity-model adaptation and representation-based prediction are already studied. The source-derived baseline shows that native head comparisons also depend on measured versus bounded affinity pairs.
config.remaining_question: On the same experimental information, which native outputs or cached representations improve target ordering beyond a capable chemistry/protein predictor, in which local generalization regime, and at what post-processing and acquisition cost?
config.practical_consequence: Choose native scoring, a cheap local predictor, label-assisted score calibration, or a representation readout according to observed gain and information/compute budget.
config.contrary_result: If matched chemistry/protein models obtain the same or better decision performance over label budgets, expensive scores do not show added value in that evaluated regime. If calibrated scalars match representations, representations add no demonstrated benefit beyond that calibration.
config.budget_definition: Known-target: nested outer-training scaffold groups with their available panel measurements. Cold-target DAVIS: nested outer-training sequence groups, fixed known molecules and fixed held-out target panels. Actual measured-cell counts reported. SPD cold-target uses all eight training targets; ten-target panel cannot support this fractional target-budget grid with three inner target folds.
config.ridge_definition: GridIntervalRidge alpha = selected candidate / number of training targets. Algorithmic grid, not scientific success/stopping criteria.
config.molecular_baseline: Equal-weight chiral Morgan radius3/2048 Tanimoto and six-descriptor RBF with training-only scaling; constant component and exact numerical kernel basis.
config.protein_baseline: Known targets: independent target basis. Cold targets: cached ESM2-650M, training-only centering/scaling, normalized linear kernel plus constant. Identical sequence hashes share outer/inner fold.
config.arms: Target prior, chemistry/protein baseline, each native output separately calibrated/added to baseline, exact-mask matched availability controls; optional shared scalar-member and cached representation readouts. No joint all-method ensemble.
config.objective: Mean squared distance to observed intervals plus coefficient ridge; unpenalized global intercept; no activity labels or imputed exact censor limits.
config.evaluation: Within-molecule target order on common finite-native support; all determinate/two exact/one bounded/two bounded. Interval and exact-only error, every query, fit cost and actual label count. No comparisons across predictions from different target-fold models.
config.pilot_contract: Only fold0/fullbudget selected arms. Inspect convergence/runtime on training fits, without held-out scoring. Does not answer scientific comparison.
config.pretrained_exposure: Local held-out does not imply absence from pretraining. Cached ESM/interaction representations are separate channels with recorded producer provenance.
config.numerical_repair: After training-only pilot reached500 iterations for a correlated representation readout, use exact invertible diagonal curvature scaling and a2000iteration cap; objective/regularization/features/data unchanged. No test metrics examined.
config.execution: Three independent dataset/regime blocks concurrently, two numerical threads per worker. Dataset/fold memberships and scientific computations fixed before launch.
config.numerical_completion: Sparse-label correlated representation fits use the identical interval-ridge objective with an exact dense active-set Newton fallback when L-BFGS stalls and the design fits a192MiB memory bound; otherwise bounded L-BFGS continuation. Completed parent SPD results are retained, not rerun.
